verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a public REST API. It has data-access endpoints that return faults and projects, plus write endpoints for reporting exceptions (POST to api.honeybadger.io/v1/notices), deployments and source maps, so a programmatic agent can drive both reading and writing core product data. Breadth is only partly evidenced, and probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. Missing for 10: an OpenAPI/Swagger spec, evidence of management actions via API (e.g. resolving or assigning faults, configuring projects), auth/rate-limit documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
